statement: Which TürKomp records enter the catalog, and in what order. Ranked by portion resolvability, because composition is available for every record but a published portion is not. This file is the rule; catalog_selection.json is its output and must never be hand-edited — use catalog_selection_overrides.json instead.

signals.test: head noun resolves to a TÜBER Ek 2.3.1 row, which publishes a portion weight
head noun is a named member of a grouped TÜBER Ek 2.1 row that states grams
head noun resolves to a whole TÜBER Ek 2.1 row that states grams
name says pişmiş/haşlanmış/kavrulmuş/közlenmiş — the form a user actually eats and logs
at most two comma clauses, so the record is a food rather than a cultivar detail

penalties.test: an anchor exists but its preparation state differs from the record's; the portion is not transferable without a human decision
name contains karışım/konsantre/hammadde/harcı — an input to cooking, not a logged food

excludeWhen.test: species qualifier (bıldırcın, devekuşu, keçi, manda, koyun, şaraplık) makes it a different food from the TÜBER row its head noun matches

note: A record with no anchor is still eligible for Tier A: its composition is published and verified, and the app asks the user for the amount. It simply scores below anything with a published portion.
